title: Construction Site Safety Monitoring

blueprintSignals.name: PPE detection
blueprintSignals.definition: probability that a detected person wears a helmet and a high-visibility vest
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Occlusion by machinery lowers accuracy, so require confidence over frames

blueprintSignals.name: Zone entry
blueprintSignals.definition: whether a person's position falls inside a polygon for an exclusion zone
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Camera calibration errors move the polygon, so recalibrate often

blueprintSignals.name: Equipment proximity
blueprintSignals.definition: estimated distance between a person and moving plant
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Depth from a single camera is imprecise

blueprintSignals.name: Event persistence
blueprintSignals.definition: number of consecutive frames in which the hazard is seen
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Longer persistence delays alerts, so balance with the 5 second limit

engineFeatures.meaning: how strongly a region stands out from its neighbourhood
the strongest local contrast anywhere in the image
contrast divided by the image's own noise level
which scanner or camera produced the image
augmentation that stops the model using overall brightness

label: For "Construction Site Safety Monitoring": Detect missing PPE, exclusion-zone entries and unsafe equipment proximity from site cameras and alert supervisors. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Staged footage is clean and well lit and overstates accuracy on real, cluttered sites.
